info.name: Generate auth keys for child container

items.docs:
Generates authorization keys for the specified child container. An `access_key` and a `secret_key` is included in the response.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: user_uuid
params.description: The UUID of the user you want to retrieve the list of child containers for.

items.docs:
Returns a list of child containers associated with the specified user. You can retrieve a list of users with the [GET /users](ref:users-list) endpoint.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: account_uuid
params.description: The UUID of the account you want to retrieve the child container history for.

items.docs:
Returns the history for child containers associated with the specified parent account UUID.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).
